title: “It’s news to me, in terms of David.”
summary: I asked Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince about his personal million-dollar donation to the Omarchy Linux project, which has dragged companies like 1Password into controversy due to creator David Heinemeier Hansson’s strident anti-immigrant views.
